Package.Name: OpenTAP
Package.Description: This is the OpenTAP package that contain the most common functionality used in test automation. It controls test plan (list of test steps) execution and provides access to functionality offered by plugins. This covers logging functionality, result handling (database) and instrument communication (user-developed hardware drivers, for example). OpenTAP also includes a CLI and a plugin manager that finds and handles plugins (test steps, DUT and Instrument interfaces, etc.). ReleasedKeysight Technologies

Plugin.Name: ConvertMajorMinorBuildRevision
Plugin.Description: Supports a four value number (x.x.x.x) which will be interpreted as Major.Minor.BuildMetadata.Patch. This is compatible with Microsoft's definition of version numbers (e.g. for .NET assemblies), see https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.version

Plugin.Name: ConvertFourValue
Plugin.Description: Supports a four value number (x.y.z.w) which will be converted to the semantic version number x.y.z+w.

Plugin.Name: Compatibility
Plugin.Description: For compatibility with TAP 8.x parsing.

Plugin.Name: cache
Plugin.Description: Operations related to the package cache.

Plugin.Name: create
Plugin.Description: Create a package based on an XML description file.

Plugin.Name: download
Plugin.Description: Download one or more packages.

Plugin.Name: install
Plugin.Description: Install the specified image, overwriting the existing installation.

Plugin.Name: install
Plugin.Description: Install one or more packages.

Plugin.Name: list
Plugin.Description: List locally installed packages and browse the online package repository.

Plugin.Name: show
Plugin.Description: Show information about a package.

Plugin.Name: test
Plugin.Description: Run tests on one or more packages.

Plugin.Name: uninstall
Plugin.Description: Uninstall one or more packages.

Plugin.Name: Test Plan Package Dependencies
Plugin.Description: Serializer plugin that inserts package dependencies for a test plan in the test plan itself.

Plugin.Name: check-updates
Plugin.Description: Checks for update for installed packages.

Plugin.Name: Delay
Plugin.Description: Waits a user defined amount of time before continuing.

Plugin.Name: Dialog
Plugin.Description: Shows a message to the user and waits for a response. A verdict can be set based on the response.

Plugin.Name: If Verdict
Plugin.Description: Runs its child steps only when the verdict of another step has a specific value.

Plugin.Name: Lock
Plugin.Description: Locks the execution of child steps based on a specified mutex.

Plugin.Name: Log Output
Plugin.Description: Outputs a specified message to the log with a specified severity.

Plugin.Name: Parallel
Plugin.Description: Runs its child steps in parallel in separate threads.

Plugin.Name: Run Program
Plugin.Description: Runs a program, and optionally applies regular expressions (regex) to the output.

Plugin.Name: Repeat
Plugin.Description: Repeats its child steps a fixed number of times or until the verdict of a child step changes to a specified state.

Plugin.Name: Generic SCPI Instrument
Plugin.Description: Allows you to configure a VISA based connection to a SCPI instrument.

Plugin.Name: SCPI
Plugin.Description: Sends a SCPI (Standard Commands for Programmable Instruments) command or query to a SCPI instrument. For queries, it processes the result with regular expressions.

Plugin.Name: Sequence
Plugin.Description: Runs its child steps sequentially.

Plugin.Name: Sweep Loop
Plugin.Description: Loops its child steps while sweeping specified parameters/settings on the child steps.

Plugin.Name: Sweep Loop (Range)
Plugin.Description: Loops all of its child steps while sweeping a specified parameter/setting over a range.

Plugin.Name: Sweep Parameter Range
Plugin.Description: Ranged based sweep step that iterates value of its parameters based on a selected range.

Plugin.Name: Sweep Parameter
Plugin.Description: Table based loop that sweeps the value of its parameters based on a set of values.

Plugin.Name: Test Plan Reference
Plugin.Description: References a test plan from an external file directly, without having to store the test plan as steps in the current test plan.

Plugin.Name: Time Guard
Plugin.Description: Tries to end the execution of a number of child steps after a specified timeout. This assumes the test steps comply with the thread abort request issued.
